summary: ERP Operating Limited Partnership, the operating partnership of Vivmark Residential, filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 disclosing that on September 16, 2026 it raised the maximum aggregate outstanding amount under its U.S. dollar commercial paper program from $1.5 billion to $2.5 billion. The unsecured notes rank pari passu with all other unsecured senior indebtedness and are sold under Section 4(a)(2) exemption without registration. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing timetable was stated. This is a routine financing-capacity increase, not a special situation; watch short-term funding markets and the REIT's liquidity headroom.
